title: Explainable intrusion detection: tutorial notebooks accompanying "An Evolution of Explainable Intrusion Detection: From Statistical Foundations to Large Language Models"
description: Jupyter notebooks demonstrating inherently explainable models (correlation, linear regression, PCA, decision trees, SVM, kNN, fuzzy logic) and post-hoc explanations (SHAP, LIME) for intrusion detection. Companion material to the survey "An Evolution of Explainable Intrusion Detection: From Statistical Foundations to Large Language Models".
